svg.aria-label: The six ordered steps of an offline emulation check: load online until the service worker controls the page, cut the network over CDP, prove it is down with a real fetch because navigator.onLine still reports true, attach the console listeners only after that proof fetch, reload and wait for the canvas, then settle every pending handle before judging.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The order the offline block has to run in

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two of these six steps exist only because getting them out of order produces a green run.

svg.text: Load online, wait until the service worker controls the page

ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the network over CDP: emulateNetworkConditions offline

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Prove it is down: fetch a junk origin, require the rejection

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: navigator.onLine still reports true under this emulation — it is not evidence of anything.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Only now attach the console listeners

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Attach before step 3 and Chrome logs its own resource error for the proof fetch, no matter what the JS catch did.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Reload, wait for the canvas the renderer actually draws to

svg.text: Judge here and you judge about two seconds before the map has finished failing its external fetches.
